business_summary: Sun Kong Holdings Limited engages in sale of diesel oil and diesel exhaust fluid in Hong Kong. The company's sale services include sourcing diesel oil through oil trading companies, dispatching fleet of diesel tank wagons to collect diesel oil from oil depots, and delivering diesel oil to customers. Additionally, it offers ancillary transportation service to an Oil Major transporting the diesel oil to its customers. The company was formerly known as Yufengchang Holdings Limited and changed its name to Sun Kong Holdings Limited in February 2025. Sun Kong Holdings Limited was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Yuen Long, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: Sun Kong Holdings Limited는 홍콩에서 디젤유 및 디젤 배기유체 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사의 판매 서비스에는 석유 무역 회사를 통한 디젤유 소싱, 석유 저장소에서 디젤유를 수집하기 위한 디젤 탱크 왜건 파견, 고객에게 디젤유 배송이 포함됩니다. 또한 디젤유를 고객에게 운송하는 석유 메이저에게 보조 운송 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Yufengchang Holdings Limited로 알려졌으며 2025년 2월에 Sun Kong Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Sun Kong Holdings Limited는 2002년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 Yuen Long에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
